adapter_policy: The story sheet (user 2026-10-27): the sheets QNC brings (catalogs/story-sheets, names as text codes), the ones an administrator makes on this computer (data/story-sheets) and the one chosen (data/story-sheet.json). The overlay fills a sheet: the project name first, then its fields one under the other, the catalog key form_next_field moving on; its editor changes names, kinds, choices, order and fields unless the sheet is locked (a plain switch). A prepared sheet is never written over: its copy gets its own id. The filled sheet and values go back to the owner, which keeps them in the project database (qnc-newsroom-sheet-db). It writes only the sheet files of this computer.
